False positives include hypotheses on returns nobody labelled. They are an upper bound unless every road user in the episodes' frames has a mask; the deltas are sounder than either arm's count.
The MOT numbers score a visible-mask position, not a body centre; body-centre, yaw, dimension, bumper and gap errors are the physical section's, against physical references.
